name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
tagline: Micro-cap broking + insurance-broking + NBFC group with modest returns and a market-cycle-linked earnings profile -- no differentiated catalyst
business_overview: SMC Global Securities is a retail broking house with insurance broking, wealth, and an NBFC lending arm. Earnings are closely tied to capital-market activity.
